effectsArray.description: Detached scene-level effects, resolved independently from transitions. Each entry is anchored to an exact scene-local frame (`frame` key) — never a percent. Resolved by resolveSceneEffects in pipeline2 and rendered by Composition.jsx SceneEffectLayer (visual) / composition-root <Sequence><Audio> (sfx).

sfxEffect.description: A SFX effect anchored to one exact scene-local frame. `frame` is 0-based against the scene's resolved durationInFrames (after TTS + transition-pad are baked in at resolve time). `durationInFrames` is optional and defaults to the audio file's own length when omitted. Backward-compat: a `timing` object (offsetPercent / relativeToAsset / relativeToCameraAction / relativeToWord) is still accepted and resolved to a concrete `frame` during pass-2 (see resolveSceneEffects), so existing manifests that author effects with `timing` keep validating and rendering. New authoring (and the agent `inject-effects` writer) should prefer the explicit `frame` form.

durationInFrames.description: Optional explicit duration. When omitted the <Audio> plays to the file's end.

frame.description: Exact scene-local frame at which the SFX starts. 0 = scene start; the scene's last frame equals scene.durationInFrames.

id.description: Unique effect id within the scene. Used for idempotent replace by `inject-effects`.

offsetPercent.description: Backward-compat legacy percent-of-scene-end (see effectTiming.js resolveEffectFrame). Deprecated — prefer `frame`. Used only when both `frame` and `timing` are absent.

path.description: Path under public/, e.g. "audio/sfx.mp3". Resolved via Remotion staticFile().

timing.description: Backward-compat legacy timing-anchor shape. Deprecated for new authoring — prefer the explicit `frame` field. When present and `frame` is omitted, resolveSceneEffects converts it to a concrete `frame` using the shared timingAnchor vocabulary.

visualEffect.description: A freestanding visual-effect asset (its own AssetComponent positioned by anchor) anchored to one exact scene-local frame. `frame` is 0-based against the scene's resolved durationInFrames. `durationInFrames` defaults to 30 when omitted. Backward-compat `timing`/`offsetPercent` shapes are kept — see sfxEffect for the deprecation notes.

assetType.description: Anything registered under studio/assets/ or studio/graphics/ that exposes an AssetComponent.

durationInFrames.description: Visible lifetime of the effect before it exits.

frame.description: Exact scene-local frame at which the visual effect enters (becomes visible).

timing.description: Backward-compat legacy timing-anchor shape. Deprecated for new authoring — prefer the explicit `frame` field.
